title: H&H集团CEO：出生率下降但婴配粉市场仍具吸引力，宠物经济成新增长点
speaker: Laetitia Garnier

segments.en: Right. You have a very unique perspective into demographic trends. I'm not sure how to phrase this question, right?
segments.zh: 您对人口趋势有独特的见解。我不知道该怎么问这个问题。

segments.en: So it's it's, you know, do people are people having more babies or we've seen the trend people having babies later in life, if not known to babies, but let's get a pet.
segments.zh: 人们是生更多孩子，还是我们看到趋势是晚育，甚至不生孩子而养宠物？

segments.en: What trends are you seeing between one against the other? Am I over? I've read some articles around that and I wonder if I'm overthinking that.
segments.zh: 您如何看待这两种趋势的对比？我读过一些文章，想知道我是否想多了。

segments.en: Is the pet economy growing quicker than the infant economy is what I'm trying to get to here?
segments.zh: 我想问的是，宠物经济是否比婴儿经济增长更快？

segments.en: Sure. I mean, I think David, there is no good or bad industry, right? There are good and bad operators, right?
segments.zh: 当然。David，我认为没有好行业或坏行业，只有好的和坏的经营者。

segments.en: So it depends upon what strategy that you want to focus, right? Yes, you're right. The global birth rate is not increasing, right?
segments.zh: 这取决于你聚焦什么战略。是的，全球出生率并没有上升。

segments.en: And that's not in one market. This is across the phenomenon, right? The fertility rates are down, right?
segments.zh: 这不是单一市场现象，而是全球现象。生育率在下降。

segments.en: But that doesn't mean that the infant formula market is not very attractive. It still remains how you get closer to the family, right?
segments.zh: 但这并不意味着婴幼儿配方奶粉市场没有吸引力。它仍然是如何更贴近家庭的问题。

segments.en: You build your trust into that, right? And biostat has done a relatively very good job in China and also the work that we've done into the French market, right?
segments.zh: 你建立信任。Biostime在中国做得很好，我们在法国市场也做了很多工作。

segments.en: With majority of our production for biostat happens. But your right pet adoption rate is increasing, right?
segments.zh: Biostime的大部分生产都在法国。但你说得对，宠物收养率在上升。

segments.en: Since COVID, we have seen the trend remaining. It is not accelerating, it is stabilizing it.
segments.zh: 自疫情以来，这一趋势持续，没有加速，而是趋于稳定。

segments.en: So yes, from a demographic perspective, yes, both rates will remain flat and will not grow to the level what it used to be.
segments.zh: 从人口角度看，出生率和收养率都将保持平稳，不会恢复到过去的水平。

segments.en: But pet adoption, they are becoming part of the family. They are treating them as their own babies, right?
segments.zh: 但宠物正在成为家庭的一部分，人们把它们当作自己的孩子。

segments.en: The fur babies or the pet and so we do see this trend more following from North America into other markets as well.
segments.zh: 毛孩子或宠物，我们看到这一趋势从北美蔓延到其他市场。

segments.en: So that's why we said we have to drive the overall revenue contribution for our pet nutrition care business, which is low double digit to closer to 20%.
segments.zh: 因此，我们必须推动宠物营养护理业务的营收贡献从低两位数提升至接近20%。

segments.en: So that demographic share, the underlying adoption rate, will be the key underlying factors for the growth.
segments.zh: 人口结构变化和潜在的收养率将是增长的关键因素。
